Dialogue_Text: Come in, curious adventurer! Come in, but remember to properly wipe your feet on the doormat. If you need to wear some slippers, there should be some on your right.

Welcome to Athkatlan Ink Gallery! A place where words become reality, and where epic tales may touch your heart, mind, and soul! I'm Viscountess Velcealle. Born Cormyrean, but now a citizen of Athkatla.
Would you like to tell me more about what you do here?
I'm not sure what that means. Do you sell ink here? Or is this some library?

Oh, you are clearly a first-timer! You've made a wonderful decision to enter this place, hidden in the shadows of the Building of Six! Splendid as it is, it can make it hard for newcomers to see our building behind that enormous edifice!

The Ink Gallery is a place that would make Deneir smile; a sanctuary that Sune would gladly visit herself, so she could read our extraordinary texts! Here, in these halls, we store tomes so intriguing, so mesmerizing, that they can make one feel as if they were real.
Ah, I believe it's a fairly new place. I do not remember hearing about it during my previous escapades, my friend.

Some say these books are able to provide quite vivid sensations. So vivid, that they can make one smile, laugh, or hurt. And we expect them to do exactly that. We want our books and their images and ink to mesmerize those that wish to face epic battles immortalized in each of our most wonderful tomes.
Uncle Quayle would love to have something like these books as part of his circus! I'm sure of it.
Hmm, I must admit, my raven, that I feel intrigued. This place reminds me of the Sensates from Sigil, their Sensorium, and these Sensory Stones they praised so much.
And you can do so, too. You can face those wonderful things, and they will fill your mind with awe-inspiring visions.
Right. So, these books describe some moments of history, and I'll be able to read about them.
It all sounds somewhat cryptic. I hope you know that.

These books do more than that! They may show you these moments; these battlefields, these people. You will be granted a chance to face those battles. The struggles. It should be a perfect way to test your skills, adventurer.

You think so? No, I don't think so. These books: they can do exactly what I say: they may show you these moments; these battlefields, these people. You will be granted a chance to face those battles. The struggles. It should be a perfect way to test your skills, adventurer.
However, remember that to learn from them, to see these places, to face people and creatures immortalized in these books, you must first pay a little fee. But it's all worth it, really.

Once you do so, you may read the book and walk the ink-created landscapes. Test yourself and... become your better, stronger self. If you succeed, I will also offer you a new souvenir in my shop. But only once you successfully return from an escapade. The more books you learn from, the more souvenirs shall become available to you.
But why am I trying to even describe it! Just see for yourself! Go on. And if you decide you want to delve into one of those stories, remember to pay the fee. I'll be around.
